parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description:
The page number in a paged query.
Default value: 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Specify the value in the YYYYMMDD format.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

- **resourceId**: resource ID.
- **trafficDay**: date.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: SearchItem
parameters.description: The IP address or instance ID of the asset.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Specify the value in the YYYYMMDD format.

parameters.name: TrafficType
parameters.description:
The type of traffic boundary for statistics. This parameter is required. Valid values:
          
- **EIP_TRAFFIC**: Internet border traffic.
  
- **NatGateway_TRAFFIC**: NAT border traffic.
- **VPC_TRAFFIC**: VPC border traffic.
